Prior review retained below:


Distinct challenge pass by the same Codex researcher, not independent human or second-agent review. Revisited all 240 literal-question responses and fifteen briefs, actors and agreement directions. Corrected national-only recall reasoning to include actual municipal mayor recall; qualified local permission is distinct from universal national recall. Verified actual SINART Articles 2–3 and current official public-enterprise opinion, replacing an ownership assumption with documented wholly state-owned broadcasting. Constitution referendum repeal is binding but subject-limited; prosecutorial presidential suspension is not an unrestricted parliamentary confidence vote. Formal courts, twenty-four-hour judicial detention and communications safeguards assessed alongside security pressure. Home searches and carrying versus possession distinguished; exact predictive police restrictions remain educated estimates. Multicultural constitutional identity and Indigenous languages are not every migrant accommodation; immigration categories and temporary-to-permanent conversion are not automatic graduation permanence. The older migration reproduction is not claimed as every amendment, and asylum is distinct from economic entry. Permanent army prohibition includes exceptional national-defence/continental-agreement forces; police are not a standing expeditionary military and peaceful priorities are not an at-all-costs prohibition. Treaty hierarchy, Inter-American authority, national currency and national immigration authority individually assessed; CPTPP negotiation conclusion is not entry into force. Public banks and ICE remain public in the assessment; BCR sale preparation and electricity draft legislation are not completed privatization. Public CCSS provision is not cash redistribution. Progressive 2026 tax bands verified, poverty assistance and childcare separate from general equalization, public allocations not assumed already spent. Catholic constitutional status and maintenance distinguish Costa Rica from a wholly secular state, while civil legislation and elected institutions are not clerical government. Christian social-justice references do not replace all positive law. Christian-oriented current school religion includes plural respect; a full compulsory-participation rule was not retrieved. Same-sex civil marriage actual registration and adoption case assessed with filiation asymmetries; neither establishes citizens’ attitudes. MEP removal of sexuality programmes distinguished from claims about complete replacement and from public-university technical criticism. Abortion litigation party claims are not court holdings; restrictive policy provides educated institutional acceptance context, not a survey. AI strategy and actual March 2026 assessment are adopted activities rather than all targets delivered. GMO regulated permissions do not authorize human embryo enhancement, brain implants or cultivated-meat substitution; former IVF prohibition is not used as a current enhancement ban. Municipal autonomy and tax authorization do not create autonomous federal provinces or separate provincial constitutions. Constitutional transfer targets are not automatically fully implemented. All sixteen culture/nature answers are trait-specific educated assumptions from actual developmental/environmental interventions, not quantitative inherited-causation findings, national IQ or racial stereotypes. neutralAnswers.rationale: Educated assumption: Municipal Code Article 19 and constitutional review allow electors to recall an elected mayor through a qualified local plebiscite. National fixed-term accountability does not establish general national representative recall. A mixed response distinguishes the actual local right from its limited coverage rather than incorrectly denying all voter recall; the full current national-office recall inventory remains unverified.

Educated assumption: Constitutional private-action protection coexists with morality, public order and drug restrictions. A mixed estimate weighs real legal limits and autonomy; an exhaustive current personal-drug enforcement audit was not available.

Educated assumption: Peaceful public assembly is protected but public-place regulation and public-order enforcement limit road obstruction. A mixed estimate addresses the exact emergency-access condition, which was not independently verified.

Educated assumption: Private autonomy coexists with public-health powers and constitutional moral/public-order limits. A mixed estimate concerns primarily self-protective adult requirements, whose precise statutory boundaries were not comprehensively audited.

Educated assumption: Public-information and expression guarantees coexist with expressly reserved state secrets. A mixed estimate reflects actual tension rather than claiming a universal misconduct-disclosure immunity.

Educated assumption: Multiethnic and multicultural constitutional identity coexists with common civic institutions. A mixed conflict estimate weighs both rather than inventing universal cultural priority.

Educated assumption: National heritage and plural traditions coexist in the constitutional cultural framework. A mixed funding-priority estimate reflects both; actual current spending by predominant tradition was not audited.
Educated assumption: Common civic law and protected distinct traditions coexist. A mixed conflict response avoids granting unconditional cultural precedence or dismissing recognized difference.
Educated assumption: Shared citizenship and education coexist with plural cultural and family identity rights. A mixed estimate does not impose immigration criteria as family identity duties.

Educated assumption: Family, pension, investment and protection routes coexist with restrictive qualification and work authorization. A mixed estimate reflects actual categories rather than unrestricted settlement or blanket exclusion.

Educated assumption: Regional connections and border-specific protections coexist with neutral family, investment and asylum categories. A mixed estimate does not equate geography and treaty status with a cultural-similarity hierarchy.

Educated assumption: Multicultural recognition coexists with economic, family and protection admission categories. A mixed estimate avoids claiming increased admission is implemented specifically because cultures differ.

Educated assumption: Exceptional national-defence organization coexists with peaceful constitutional principles. A mixed estimate addresses a substantiated imminent attack; a precise anticipatory-force doctrine was not verified.

Educated assumption: Strong peaceful commitments coexist with constitutionally possible national defence and continental obligations. A mixed estimate rejects both a standing war posture and an invented at-all-costs prohibition.

Educated assumption: Treaties can have higher authority than statutes while constitutional sovereign institutions remain. This is a substantive mixed legal hierarchy, not unlimited institutional surrender. Most likely Neutral. The cited facts provide contextual evidence for an institutional estimate, not a verified explicit national endorsement of this exact statement. Accepted treaty commitments and retained sovereignty have different scopes; no unrestricted stance across every international institution is assumed.
Educated assumption: Sovereignty and national public-interest policy coexist with accepted international obligations. A mixed estimate distinguishes generic goals from binding rights judgments.

Educated assumption: Competitive private activity coexists with retained public providers in overlapping markets. A mixed equal-performance ownership estimate reflects both rather than inventing a universal preference.

Educated assumption: No permanent military coexists with public control of strategic utility and resource infrastructure and private regulated business. A mixed estimate avoids equating national security with one ownership model.

Educated assumption: Public strategic retention coexists with reform and sale proposals for public firms. A mixed estimate does not invent an automatic repeated-loss sale rule or assume all firms must be retained.

Educated assumption: Broad tariff liberalization coexists with agricultural and selected-sector protection. A mixed response reflects actual differentiated trade rather than treating all safety certificates as protection. Most likely Neutral. The cited facts provide contextual evidence for an institutional estimate, not a verified explicit national endorsement of this exact statement. Product, sector and treaty exceptions qualify the general choice; remedies, tariffs and investment screening are distinct instruments.
Educated assumption: Openness coexists with strategic supply and agriculture protection. A mixed essential-goods estimate avoids inventing either a blanket restriction or a blanket free-import rule.

Educated assumption: Foreign-currency contracting and financial-market freedom coexist with sovereign currency and monetary regulation. A mixed estimate distinguishes private asset use from verified unrestricted private currency issuance.

Educated assumption: Poverty assistance and progressive tax coexist with fiscal austerity. A mixed estimate weighs social protection and limits rather than assuming willingness for every higher-tax minimum-income expansion.

Educated assumption: Fiscal restraint and individual earnings coexist with progressive taxation and cash assistance. A mixed estimate reflects simultaneous implemented goals rather than uniform retention priority.

Educated assumption: Targeted conditional assistance and progression toward self-sufficiency coexist with continuing poverty support. A mixed estimate does not invent a universal working-age expiry; exact programme duration and renewals vary and were not fully audited.

Educated assumption: Fiscal limits coexist with public social-protection goals. A mixed estimate weighs actual restraint and assistance rather than claiming modesty exists solely to lower funders’ taxes.

Educated assumption: Basic-needs targeting coexists with social participation, development and opportunity aims. A mixed response reflects policy design and constrained adequacy rather than assuming all recipients reach ordinary social-life participation.
Educated assumption: Fiscal consolidation and targeted social-transfer commitments coexist. A mixed estimate avoids inventing an all-household tax-cut-versus-benefit priority.

Educated assumption: Constitutional rural fairness and property compensation coexist with private ownership. A mixed estimate addresses actual social-function principles without inventing a comprehensive current compensated large-landholding redistribution programme.

Educated assumption: Constitutional Catholic state recognition and Christian social-justice references coexist with civil legislation; religious teaching does not directly replace enacted law. Most likely Neutral. The cited facts provide contextual evidence for an institutional estimate, not a verified explicit national endorsement of this exact statement. Civil authority, faith accommodation and heritage practice may coexist; personal belief does not establish religion’s governmental role.

Educated assumption: Current religious education invokes Christian principles and inclusive respect, rather than wholly descriptive secular comparison. A mixed estimate allows plural freedoms; exact compulsory participation and all course content were not audited.

Educated assumption: Civil family courts coexist with recognized legal effects of some religious marriage procedures. A mixed estimate avoids equating religious rites with an independently binding religious family judiciary; exact exceptions were not audited.

Educated assumption: Marriage equality and multicultural constitutional change coexist with sexuality-curriculum removal and conservative policy. A mixed estimate reflects actual divergent changes rather than one uniform social direction.
Educated assumption: Tradition-oriented educational and religious policy coexists with continuing civil equality reforms. A mixed priority estimate reflects competing implemented institutions.

Educated assumption: Constitutional sex equality coexists with family-first sexual education and Christian-oriented traditions. A mixed institutional estimate does not use the president’s sex or citizens’ opinions as a shortcut.
Educated assumption: Religious and family traditions coexist with personal freedom and plural culture. A mixed dress-norm estimate does not invent a state-required modesty code.

Educated assumption: Identity and equality rights coexist with traditional official conventions and recent school policy restrictions. A mixed estimate reflects contested institutional practice; exact current universal chosen-language duties were not retrieved.

Educated assumption: Marriage reform took effect after judicial transition while curriculum removal occurred quickly. A mixed estimate reflects different actual reform speeds rather than a universal gradualism doctrine.

Educated assumption: AI-development institutions and GMO permissions coexist with environmental, ethical and safety controls. A mixed broad-use threshold reflects both; adoption plans are not wholesale completed deployment.

Educated assumption: Biotechnology authorization extends beyond research while responsible-AI assessment and health controls remain. A mixed estimate does not invent a universal long-term trial-only rule.

Educated assumption: Public infrastructure goals coexist with constitutional environmental protection. A mixed benefit-versus-habitat estimate reflects actual competing aims; no all-project approval threshold was verified.

Educated assumption: Scientific development and biosafety caution coexist. A mixed cultivated-meat estimate does not invent a specific approval, commercial substitution or environmental-risk exemption; exact product policy was not located.

Educated assumption: Technology-led decarbonization and environmental conservation coexist. A mixed estimate does not infer a universal technology-versus-consumption hierarchy from renewable electricity alone.

Educated assumption: Housing/transport development and environmental preservation coexist. A mixed land-priority response reflects actual competing institutions rather than an unconditional infrastructure-first rule.

Educated assumption: Local land-use responsibilities coexist with national environmental and resource institutions. A mixed estimate addresses effects confined locally without creating autonomous provincial wildlife sovereignty.

Educated assumption: Developmental monitoring and individualized care coexist with favorable environments. An interaction estimate is likelier for stress sensitivity; no adopted trait-specific causal ranking was found.

Educated assumption: Developmental monitoring and tailored support coexist with environmental stimulation. A mixed attention estimate weighs both actual strands; exact predominance was not established.

Educated assumption: Individual developmental differences coexist with environmental and caregiving intervention. An interaction estimate is likelier for temperament specifically; neither predominance is quantified.
